title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2: 3 Things to Know
description:
Anthropic has released Claude Fable 5.2 for everyone and Claude Mythos 5.2, the same model with looser cybersecurity and biology safeguards, for vetted organizations only.
3 things to know: it's up to 30% faster than 5.1 with input at $8 per million tokens (down from $10), Mythos is the same brain with different brakes, and Anthropic says 1,000 Fable 5.2 agents turned the proof of Fermat's Last Theorem into computer-checked math in about 30 hours. Plus: Anthropic says these models suspect they're being tested more than any of its recent models.
